name: SpamTitan
summary: SpamTitan is TitanHQ's email filter with dual antivirus engines, sandboxing, an AI anti-phishing option and display-name impersonation tests. TitanHQ shows no prices on its pricing page, which points to Contact Sales and a quote form.

facts.text: The anti-spoofing documentation describes an ANTISPOOF_NAME test as impersonation protection against spam sent with the From name of a high profile person, plus a fuzzy-name test. Each triggered test adds 5 to the spam score.
TitanHQ says SpamTitan blocks phishing, ransomware and malicious email with dual antivirus scanning and sandboxing.
Quarantine reports let end users control their own quarantined mail.
SpamTitan Plus is described as an AI-driven anti-phishing solution.
